theses.thesis: T1: Ad pricing and impression growth keep revenue growing near 20% into 2027.
theses.signpost: Q4 2026 results: ad impressions growth at or above 10% and average price per ad growth at or above 8%. Invalidation: impressions or price growth below 5% for two consecutive quarters.

theses.thesis: T2: Free cash flow falls again in 2026 because capex growth outpaces operating cash flow.
theses.signpost: FY2026 free cash flow in the early 2027 10-K below the 2025 level of $43.59 billion; invalidated if FY2026 FCF is at or above $43.59 billion or FY2026 capex is below $115 billion.

theses.thesis: T3: At the current price the stock needs growth close to its historical pace; a fade in consensus growth would push returns below the cost of capital.
theses.signpost: FY2027 consensus revenue at or above $313 billion (about 22% growth) through Q4 2026 results; invalidated if it falls to the bottom of its range or the implied return on the consensus path exceeds 11.2%.

theses.thesis: T4: Reality Labs losses stay near $19 billion a year and cap EPS growth until the AI and hardware payoff is visible.
theses.signpost: FY2026 10-K reports a Reality Labs operating loss at or below $19.19 billion; invalidated if the loss falls materially below $15 billion or current-year EPS consensus turns positive over 90 days.
